routes.composition: Standalone SafeRoute sibling of the Layout route at App.tsx:573; lazy page declaration at App.tsx:355.
routes.entry: ServerGate permits /connect and redirects to it when needsServerSetup() returns true.

purpose: Standalone server-origin and optional personal access token setup for generic Capacitor/Electron shells, also reachable for manual server switching.
primaryGoal: Validate the chosen TeslaSync origin and authentication requirement, retain the connection through existing storage policy, then fully reload onto that server without weakening authentication or certificate protections.

dataSources.name: Saved server origin
dataSources.hook: No query hook; useState(getServerBaseUrl) reads the existing connection owner once.
dataSources.behavior: Reads and normalizes localStorage origin; absent, invalid or unreadable value resolves to empty. Token field starts empty rather than revealing a stored token.

dataSources.name: Candidate server authentication-mode probe
dataSources.hook: probeServer; imperative user-triggered connection operation, not normal cached page data.
dataSources.behavior: Ten-second AbortController timeout; credentials omitted; supplied token is sent only as an authorization header. 401 becomes authenticationRequired; other HTTP failures, malformed response, timeout and transport failures become generic failure. Nonempty string mode is returned; the page specifically checks forward_auth.
dataSources.limits: Route registration matches the URL. Handler payload, reverse-proxy behavior, CORS, TLS trust, token validity and native transport are not exercised or fully traced. Do not infer that a successful mode discovery proves all authenticated API access.

dataSources.name: Connection persistence and reboot
dataSources.behavior: Normalized origin and token-required marker use existing localStorage keys; trimmed token uses sessionStorage only; legacy localStorage token is removed. Successful save navigates to / for a complete reboot. A storage exception yields a recoverable page alert. Native restart without the required session token returns to setup while keeping the origin.
dataSources.limits: Storage transaction atomicity, browser policy and reload/provider behavior are unverified.

components.name: GlassPanel
components.contract: w-full max-w-md p-6 caller; default glow=none and hover=false; shared panel tokens and forced-color surface.

components.name: PageHeader
components.contract: Localized title/subtitle, decorative server icon; compactHeader defaults true. Subtitle is accessible through the existing More info tooltip rather than permanently visible. h1 route-focus target and FadeIn remain.

components.name: Input
components.contract: Controlled server and masked token fields, generated stable useId associations, labels, hint descriptions, native props and focus tokens. Default size md is min-h-10.

components.name: Button
components.contract: Primary submit, size md, full width; loading disables button and supplies aria-busy with decorative spinner. Existing wrapLabel and lg size support are available.

components.name: Text and ErrorText
components.contract: Localized forward-auth caption and semantic role=alert error paragraph; preserve as overrides and shared typography roles.

components.name: usePageTitle and Icons
components.contract: Localized document title restores previous base title on unmount; server/key icons are decorative and aria-hidden.

duplicatedPatterns.assessment: Two fields correctly reuse Input; header, surface, alert and submit reuse existing category barrels. No new duplicate component is justified by this single-page scope.
duplicatedPatterns.limits: No application-wide duplication inventory was performed.

responsive.sourceStrategy: One centered stacked form, min-h-dvh, outer p-4, w-full max-w-md panel with p-6. Constrained form width is appropriate for this standalone setup task, not an analytical full-width report.

issues.detail: Centered min-height layout and fixed nested padding need real short-height/mobile-keyboard and long-localized-copy review; no source-only proof of clipping or safe scrolling is available.
issues.fix: Validate all required widths plus short-height native keyboard states and 200% text. If overflow is observed, use existing spacing and scroll composition while preserving every field, hint, error and action.
issues.confidence: medium; verification risk, not reproduced defect

sourcePositives: Semantic form submission and shared h1 route-focus target.
Input provides label association and hint descriptions; password masking and URL keyboard hint are retained.
Decorative icons are aria-hidden; submit loading exposes aria-busy; ErrorText exposes role=alert.
PageHeader uses shared FadeIn, whose reduced-motion path sets initial=false and derives timing from useMotionPreference.

issues.detail: The page has only a general error string and alert. Neither Input receives error or an association to that alert, so invalid-origin and missing/rejected-token feedback does not mark its responsible field aria-invalid.
issues.fix: Track field ownership for existing failures and use Input.error or explicit described-by wiring without duplicate announcements. Retain a general alert for transport/storage failures and preserve all existing rejection messages.

issues.detail: Submit size md maps to h-10 (40px); fields default to min-h-10. This is below the contract's 44px stronger mobile default, but actual hit rectangles and WCAG spacing exceptions were not measured.
issues.fix: Reuse existing Button/Input lg or scoped minimum-height classes for mobile reachability; do not change global density defaults or claim measured WCAG failure without browser evidence.
issues.confidence: high for declared sizing; runtime target compliance unverified

issues.detail: Server autofocus may interact with the shared route-focus manager and native virtual keyboard; existing test source expects autofocus, but real focus order and keyboard behavior are unverified.
issues.fix: Exercise first-run and manual /connect entry with keyboard and native soft keyboard. Preserve intentional autofocus and route-focus semantics unless a verified conflict requires coordinated integration.

accessibility.runtimeStatus: Keyboard, screen-reader announcements, tooltip visibility, composed contrast, touch targets and reduced-motion rendering NOTRUN.

states.initial: Saved normalized origin or empty field, empty token, no mode hint/error, idle submit. Blank configuration is an actionable setup state, not an empty data panel.
states.loading: busy blocks repeated submissions and disables/loading-labels submit; fields remain editable.
states.validation: Six localized URL rejection categories return before probing.
states.authentication: 401 distinguishes missing from rejected token; successful forward_auth discovery without token shows mode hint and token-required alert.
states.error: Generic unreachable alert for other probe failures; storage/save catch displays enabled-storage recovery guidance; same form permits retry.
states.success: Persist through existing helper then navigate to /; no success screen is needed for a reboot flow.
states.offline: Not separately identified from transport/HTTP/malformed-response failure.
states.stalePartial: No historical dataset or refresh cache on this form; stale and partial data states are not applicable. Do not add fabricated status badges.

issues.detail: Timeout, network/CORS/TLS failures, non-401 HTTP failures and invalid payload all produce the same unreachable message because the existing helper exposes no reason.
issues.fix: Coordinate an extension of the existing probe result contract for observable timeout/HTTP/invalid-response reasons and a truthful unknown transport fallback. Never claim JavaScript can always distinguish TLS from CORS or offline, and never offer certificate/auth bypass instructions.

issues.detail: Fields stay editable during the probe, while the async submit closes over the server/token values from its starting render. Later edits can differ from the values saved on success.
issues.fix: Make the in-flight candidate unambiguous with existing disabled field states or an explicit attempt snapshot and cancel/retry policy. Preserve entered values on failure and do not publish token content in a status summary.
issues.confidence: high for source control flow; runtime interaction not exercised

visualIssues.detail: No explicit neon classes, glow props, saturated gradients or fixed pure-white classes appear in this page. GlassPanel defaults to no hover/glow; header and primary action inherit theme accent. Effective brightness/saturation and white-on-accent contrast cannot be certified from source.
visualIssues.fix: Retain neutral shared surface/text tokens and one restrained primary action. Flag actual excessive accent saturation/glow/pure-white noise during theme QA rather than adding a local palette or resetting saved theme choices.
visualIssues.confidence: high for literal/default inspection; visual appearance unverified

visualIssues.detail: Existing compact PageHeader moves introductory subtitle to its help tooltip. Guidance is not source-deleted, but visibility and discoverability for first-run users require real touch/keyboard review.
visualIssues.fix: Preserve the entire introduction and help action. If it proves hard to discover, use existing compactHeader=false or an existing Text role for visible guidance, without inventing another header component.
visualIssues.confidence: high for composition; usability impact unverified

architectureIssues.detail: Page orchestrates an imperative candidate-origin probe through the existing connection module, not request() or a query hook. This is a justified setup boundary: saved-origin clients cannot validate an unsaved candidate. No competing fetch/query implementation is introduced in the page.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep URL, transport, storage and auth policy in serverConnection; retain the full reload boundary and existing native gate. Do not mechanically replace this with a normal cached hook, duplicate server state store or hot-swapped provider.
architectureIssues.confidence: high; source-confirmed architectural constraint, not a violation

priority.rationale: Safety-sensitive first-run/native access form already reuses shared primitives and has little literal visual noise. Prioritize field-level feedback, in-flight input clarity and mobile reachability; coordinate truthful transport recovery without changing auth/storage safety.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing ServerProbeFailure reason contract extension
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Extend the existing discriminated ServerProbeResult rather than inventing another connection service: retain ok and authenticationRequired; optionally add observable timeout, HTTP-status and invalid-response reasons, with unknown transport fallback. Preserve the ten-second timeout, cookie omission, token-header privacy and current save guards.
requiredSharedChanges.status: Proposed existing-owner extension; not implemented. No evidence for a new shared presentation component or additional consumers in this scope.

New ModernCard/header/form/error system instead of category-barrel primitives.
A second auth/token persistence mechanism, localStorage token storage or certificate-warning bypass.
A workspace/date/vehicle selector on this standalone setup route.

dataBehavior: Keep missing scheme defaulting to HTTPS, accepted HTTP/LAN origins, normalization and all six URL-rejection categories.
Reject credentials embedded in URL and unsupported subpaths; retain masked token entry and localized security guidance.
Keep auth-required/rejected distinction and fail-before-save checks; never bypass server authentication or browser/native certificate warnings.
Keep server origin separate from session-only token; never include tokens in report, logs, URLs, help, screenshot summaries or new persistence.
Keep existing connection/token-required storage keys and native re-entry policy, same-origin behavior and full-reload cache/provider boundary.
Retain existing theme, typography, motion, density and locale settings through shared components; do not reset settings for aesthetics.
No charts, metrics, dates, units, tables, exports or specialist analytics exist on this page; do not fabricate them.
